kernel_core.scope: 6.18 core reference; LOS SM8550 repositories remain the selected driver foundation

reference.strategy: recompiled SoC/techpack/device modules plus selected madrid 6.18 binaries; embedded replacement module layer

board_sources.name: lineage-kernel
board_sources.scope: Current ROM-pinned LOS SM8550 5.15 driver foundation; migrate required interfaces to 6.18

board_sources.name: lineage-modules
board_sources.scope: LOS Qualcomm and Xiaomi external drivers; audit tablet touch, pen, keyboard, display, audio and camera coverage

board_sources.name: lineage-devicetrees
board_sources.scope: LOS SM8550 hardware definitions, checked against sheng stock DTB/DTBO

source_policy: Use LOS official sources as requested; withdrawn MiCode sheng catalogs are not build inputs. Keep the existing ROM checkout pinned and unchanged.

board_groups.name: display
board_groups.requires: tablet LCD dual-DSI/DSC and original display userspace ABI

board_groups.name: touch-and-pen
board_groups.requires: Tablet Novatek host-processing and pen path, sourced from LOS where available

board_groups.name: keyboard-and-hall
board_groups.requires: tablet-specific input protocols and screen notifications

board_groups.name: audio
board_groups.requires: tablet speaker amp; reference CS35L41 alone is insufficient

board_groups.name: fingerprint
board_groups.requires: tablet FPC and panel notification interfaces

release_gates: Complete built 6.18 candidate and all effective modules
Real symbol CRCs, module_layout, structure size, dependencies, namespaces and signature checks
Merged tablet DTB/DTBO matches enabled drivers
Original init/vendor ramdisk remains in charge, with any replacement module layer explicitly audited
Boot/package/AVB validation against actual sheng partitions
Authorized device boot and hardware checks on LineageOS; HyperOS tested separately
